title: City Council District 1
statement: I'm standing with Brooklyn — not because it's easy, but because it's right. The numbers don't lie: sentiment at -0.12 against a citywide -0.008, property crime at 37, and decay momentum building to 3. This isn't a blip; it's a pattern. And the people in my district are feeling it every day — Kaila closing the bakery earlier, Drago and Sefu watching their block change, Minh seeing fewer jobs on the board. The Tenant Defense Fund is moving — I'm filing the ordinance today because displacement doesn't pause for process. And to Brooklyn's storefronts: submit your municipal service plans by week's end so we can direct stabilization dollars where they'll matter most.

payload.text: I cast my vote to advance the West Oakland Tenant Defense Fund (INIT-010) and I'm directing stabilization dollars to the Brooklyn corridor — municipal service plans due by week's end so we target relief where the decay is building.
